message.content: why does the migration test hang?

content.text: Let me look at the migration runner.

Root cause: TypeORM 0.2 runs all pending migrations in one transaction, so migration 14 waits on a lock that migration 12 holds. The fix is transaction: "each" in the data source; the suite went from a 600 s hang to 41 s.
Committed 5e6f7a8b, tests 212/0. Pushing the branch now.
